gloss: sense of fulfillment; worth doing; rewarding

definitions.gloss: sense of fulfillment; being worth doing; rewarding quality
definitions.explanation: The feeling that an activity is meaningful and worth the effort. Something that makes one feel satisfied and motivated when doing or accomplishing it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧やり{甲斐|がい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
やり{甲斐|がい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じられる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a job where I can feel a sense of fulfillment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦だからこそ→だからこそ：27569_dakarakoso⟧、やり{甲斐|がい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Precisely because it's a difficult challenge, it's worth doing.

notes:
やり{甲斐|がい} is the sense that an effort is worth making — the reward one gets back from doing something demanding. It is a property of the activity as experienced, so it takes ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (this job has it) rather than a verb of doing.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- やり{甲斐|がい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to be rewarding/worth doing)
- やり{甲斐|がい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel a sense of fulfillment)
- やり{甲斐|がい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (a rewarding job)

PRODUCTIVE PATTERN 〜{甲斐|がい}:
⟦{甲斐|かい}→甲斐：15851_kai⟧ attaches to a verb's masu-stem — voiced to -がい in this position — to mean 'worth doing [verb]'. The base here is ⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧:
- ⟦{生|い}き{甲斐|がい}→生き甲斐：06654_ikigai⟧ (reason for living, purpose in life)
- ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ → {読|よ}み{甲斐|がい} (worth reading)
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ → {見|み}{甲斐|がい} (worth seeing)
- ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ → {食|た}べ{甲斐|がい} (worth eating, filling)

WORK CULTURE:
やり{甲斐|がい} comes up constantly in Japanese workplace talk, and employee surveys treat it as a headline metric. Note the critical coinage やり{甲斐|がい}⟦{搾取|さくしゅ}→搾取：12820_sakushu⟧ ('fulfillment exploitation') — using an appeal to meaningful work to justify poor pay.

WRITING:
Usually written all in hiragana as やりがい outside formal writing.
